entries.institution: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
entries.description: I am studying physics with a focus on astrophysics at UNC–Chapel Hill, with an expected graduation in May 2027. My coursework connects numerical methods and fundamental physics with astronomical observations and analysis.

awards.name: North Carolina Space Grant Undergraduate Scholarship
awards.description: Awarded a competitive $8,000 NASA-funded undergraduate research scholarship supporting the development of Skynet’s optical data-processing pipeline and astronomical analysis tools.

awards.name: Honors Carolina
awards.description: Selected for UNC–Chapel Hill’s undergraduate honors program, which admits approximately 10% of each incoming class.
